🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?

Style: mixed / no clear leadership; major divergences argue for tactical positioning, not core-position conviction.

🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

Price-level data was not supplied, so specific support and resistance levels cannot be stated. Monitor whether NVDA (1W: -7.08% | 1M: -16.35%) BELOW TREND stabilizes, and whether JPM (1W: +3.78% | 1M: +6.29%) ABOVE TREND and BKNG (1W: +15.57% | 1M: +8.46%) ABOVE TREND sustain their trends.

📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL regime, with no clear Growth-versus-Value leadership; breadth is 9/11 sectors positive, but Technology and Energy weakness temper the strength. Relative strength sits in LOW (1W: +15.61% | 1M: +25.68%) ABOVE TREND and JPM (1W: +3.78% | 1M: +6.29%) ABOVE TREND. Major trend divergences warrant monitoring, while negative VST sentiment is confirmed by VST (1W: -15.72% | 1M: -25.05%) BELOW TREND.
